How do you run AI agents while you're on holiday? My AI edits my videos and my PC never leaves the house.
An old laptop connects to my PC at home, so all the power and compute stays there. Hermes (an AI agent harness) runs the jobs: video edits, my Notion board clean-up and Telegram messages. Every edit lands in Telegram as a preview and I watch it on my phone. Claude Code straight on my phone was too finicky.

guide: This sets up an AI agent that does jobs for you while your main PC stays at home and you are away. You need a PC that stays on at home, an old laptop, an open-source agent framework (for example Hermes), Telegram, and Notion if you want board clean-up.
1. Leave your powerful PC at home, switched on, as the machine that does the heavy work.
1. Set up an old laptop and connect it to the home PC over a remote connection, so the laptop is only your way in and the PC supplies the power and compute.
1. Install an open-source agent framework on the home PC and give it the jobs you want done, such as video edits and Notion board clean-up.
1. Create a bot with Telegram's BotFather and connect it to the agent framework, so the agent can message you and you can message it.
1. Make each finished edit arrive in Telegram as a preview video rather than a final post.
1. Watch the preview on your phone and reply yes or no, so nothing goes out without your approval.
1. Keep Claude Code on the home PC for building and fixing the setup, and use Telegram for day-to-day control.
Watch out: running Claude Code directly from a phone was too finicky and struggled, so use Telegram as the phone-side control and keep the real work on the home PC.

```
You are helping me build a remote AI agent setup so my jobs keep running while I am away from home.
My setup: a PC at home that stays on, an old laptop I can carry, a Telegram account, and <list any other tools, e.g. Notion, ffmpeg, CapCut>. My main job to automate is <describe job, e.g. editing videos from raw clips>. My operating system is <Windows/macOS/Linux>.
Build this:
1. An open-source agent framework, such as Hermes Agent, running on the home PC, with the job above set up as a task it can run.
2. A secure remote connection from the old laptop to the home PC, so the PC does all the processing.
3. A Telegram bot that the agent uses to send me updates and receive my replies.
4. A step where every finished result is sent to me in Telegram as a preview, and nothing is published or changed until I reply yes. If I reply no, it should ask what to change.
Constraints: keep every token and password in environment variables, never in the code. Only my Telegram account may control the bot. Explain each step in plain English and tell me how to test it.
Return the setup steps in order, any code or config files in full, and a short checklist to confirm it works while I am away.
```
